mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_RESPONSE ( PARENT_SN, PARENT_TYPE, USER_SN, RSPSN_CN, RSPSN_DT, DEL_YN, VIEW_CNT ) VALUES ( #{dto.parentSn}, #{dto.parentType}, #{dto.userSn}, #{dto.response}, NOW(), FALSE, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT RSPSN_SN, PARENT_TYPE, PARENT_SN, USER_SN, RSPSN_DT, RSPSN_CN, VIEW_CNT, DEL_YN FROM TB_RESPONSE WHERE PARENT_SN = #{parentSn} AND USER_SN = #{userSn} AND DEL_YN = FALSE ORDER BY RSPSN_DT DESC
SELECT RSPSN_SN, PARENT_TYPE, PARENT_SN, USER_SN, RSPSN_DT, RSPSN_CN, VIEW_CNT, DEL_YN FROM TB_RESPONSE WHERE RSPSN_SN = #{rspsnSn}

SELECT R.RSPSN_SN, R.PARENT_TYPE, R.PARENT_SN, R.USER_SN, U.USER_NM AS userName, R.RSPSN_DT, R.RSPSN_CN, R.VIEW_CNT, R.DEL_YN FROM TB_RESPONSE R LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON R.USER_SN = U.USER_SN WHERE R.PARENT_SN = #{parentSn} AND R.DEL_YN = FALSE ORDER BY R.RSPSN_DT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_RESPONSE SET DEL_YN = TRUE, RSPSN_DT = NOW() WHERE RSPSN_SN = #{rspsnSn} AND (USER_SN = #{userSn} OR #{userSn} IS NULL)
